title: The WPBot – AI ChatBot for WordPress & Growth Suite: SEO, AI Writer, Email Marketing, Social Media plugin for…
description: The WPBot – AI ChatBot for WordPress & Growth Suite plugin is vulnerable to a Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) flaw via the 'text' parameter in all versions up to and including 9.1. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when an administrator views the Chat Sessions screen. The issue arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, specifically involving the plugin's use of Bootstrap 3.3.7 affix data-API passing attacker-controlled data to jQuery as HTML.
